panels.description: Each lane receives the same causal snapshot. Policy changes only the market universe; duration cap and trailing lock are isolated, mutually exclusive exit mechanisms tested across all edges.

targets.queryText: SELECT c.policy_id AS 'Policy', c.scenario_id AS 'Edge Scenario', c.edge_threshold AS 'Edge Threshold', COALESCE(c.stop_loss_fraction,0) AS 'Stop Loss', c.profit_target_multiplier AS 'Profit Target', COALESCE(c.duration_cap_minutes,0) AS 'Duration Cap (min)', COALESCE(c.trailing_activation_margin,0) AS 'Trailing Margin', c.lane_id AS 'Lane', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=1 THEN t.simulated_net_pnl ELSE 0 END),0) AS 'Simulated Net P&L', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=1 THEN 1 END) AS 'Closed Trades', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=0 THEN 1 END) AS 'Open Positions' FROM strategy_lane_catalog c LEFT JOIN strategy_lane_trades t ON t.lane_id=c.lane_id AND (t.run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring}='__current__' AND t.run_id=(SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='strategy_input_run_id')) WHERE c.lane_id IN (${lane_id:sqlstring}) GROUP BY c.lane_id ORDER BY c.policy_id,c.edge_threshold,c.duration_cap_minutes,c.trailing_activation_margin
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT c.policy_id AS 'Policy', c.scenario_id AS 'Edge Scenario', c.edge_threshold AS 'Edge Threshold', COALESCE(c.stop_loss_fraction,0) AS 'Stop Loss', c.profit_target_multiplier AS 'Profit Target', COALESCE(c.duration_cap_minutes,0) AS 'Duration Cap (min)', COALESCE(c.trailing_activation_margin,0) AS 'Trailing Margin', c.lane_id AS 'Lane', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=1 THEN t.simulated_net_pnl ELSE 0 END),0) AS 'Simulated Net P&L', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=1 THEN 1 END) AS 'Closed Trades', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat=0 THEN 1 END) AS 'Open Positions' FROM strategy_lane_catalog c LEFT JOIN strategy_lane_trades t ON t.lane_id=c.lane_id AND (t.run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring}='__current__' AND t.run_id=(SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='strategy_input_run_id')) WHERE c.lane_id IN (${lane_id:sqlstring}) GROUP BY c.lane_id ORDER BY c.policy_id,c.edge_threshold,c.duration_cap_minutes,c.trailing_activation_margin
